name: claypot-mern
description: A full-stack recipe-sharing platform built with the MERN stack.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names client,server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint:e2e && npm run lint:deployment
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:deployment
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:e2e && npm run typecheck:deployment
